status: final draft: the design approved by the owner; the driver implemented, for independent review; not locked and not run. The lock (PROTOCOL.md §8) pins every file in "lock", in a commit of its own; it does not authorize a run.
description: V0.12b Stage B: at 12 recorded branch points, the recorded state, conversation and initial staffing proposal, then two whole decision workflows (A llm-agent 5 validation-first-preview, B llm-agent 6 consequence acknowledgment), Gemma 10 and Qwen 20 draws per arm per point, one model request at a time.
method: shared-prefix/v4 (docs/benchmark/v11b-dev/SPEC.md), with arms A and B as below

A.name: llm-agent 5, validation-first-preview (llm-agent-workflow/v1)
A.workflow: llm_agent5.ask(..., workflow="validation-first-preview"), the agent's own code: validation first; a refusal answered with llm-agent-validation-feedback/v1; the read-only preview of the first fully valid proposal with staffing actions, shown when llm-agent-preview-eligibility/v1 finds a reason, with llm-agent-selective-preview/v1; the reply validated again

B.name: llm-agent 6, consequence acknowledgment (llm-agent-acknowledgment-workflow/v1)
B.workflow: llm_agent6.ask(...), the agent's own code: validation first, as A, without the selective preview; a fully valid proposal's consequences read from the engine's preview; a qualifying proposal (termination, displaced bookings, hire, teleradiology start) answered with the acknowledgment request; matched exactly; final re-validation and re-preview; submitted only if both pass; otherwise withheld

arms.shared: every arm: the recorded state, the recorded request (system prompt, prompt, earlier exchanges), the recorded initial proposal as the model's first reply, maxRetries 1 and allowDetails as the frozen settings (failures and details already used before the proposal carried over); the same final-response schema; only a fully validated proposal submitted
arms.differences: at a valid qualifying proposal, A shows the selective preview when eligible and B the acknowledgment request; at a valid non-qualifying proposal, A shows the preview when eligible and B calls no model; at a refused proposal both answer with the same validation feedback, and then differ at the corrected proposal as above. Model calls are counted per draw, not equalized

settings.loadedBy: llm_agent3.load_settings, unchanged; the base URL from DREAMTEAM_LLM_BASE_URL
settings.decisionBudget: the settings' 900 s, applied by each agent as it applies it; with at most 2 model calls per draw of at most 300 s each, it cannot be reached

drawsBasis: V0.10b, V0.10c and V0.11b: Gemma gave one decision per arm at every point in 10–20 draws; Qwen gave 1–6 distinct decisions per arm in 20
order: per model in modelOrder; its draws as rounds; in each round every point and arm of the model once, in the order of SHA-256('dreamteam-v12b-order/1|<model>|<round>|<point id>|<arm>'); one draw, and one model request, at a time
preflight: GET /health, /v1/models and /openapi.json only; no inference preflight

request.body: the recorded proposal request (model, messages, temperature 0, max_tokens 4096, response_format json_object) with its messages followed by the workflow's turns; nothing added

server.observed: before the run, before each round and after: /health, server version, OpenAPI SHA-256, both models' entries; cached tokens per response
server.material: server version, OpenAPI SHA-256 or either model's entry changes, or /health not healthy
unavailable: cache clearing, cache disabling, cold starts, server settings: admin-only, not used

engine: one session per point on the recording's replay transcript, at the recorded digests; validate, preview, observe and digests only (read-only); every request and answer recorded with the draw

stop.maxModelCallsPerDraw: 4, checked before every model request: a draw reaching it is interrupted and the run stops (with maxRetries 1 a draw makes at most 2)
stop.wallClock: a model request starts only if its whole timeout (300 s) fits before 14,400 s, and a draw only if the same holds; no request is cut short
stop.health: an unhealthy /health before a round stops the run
stop.serverChange: a material change before a round stops the run
stop.driver: any other exception during a draw stops the run; run.json is still written
stop.partial: a run that stops before its last draw is PARTIAL: the interrupted draw is recorded and replayed, not classified; the analysis reports only what was observed, with no B − A comparison and no pooled summary (PROCEDURE.md §4)
stop.resume: never: run refuses a directory that holds a run, and the driver has no resume; any continuation needs the owner's separate authorization and a documented protocol decision (an amendment)

failures: every request recorded; a failure handled only by the arm's own workflow (a resend within its retries), never rerun outside it
outcomes: PROTOCOL.md §5: per draw the proposal (kept, revised, abandoned; or refused, withheld, invalid), the final proposal's validity, submission and execution; B's classes A–E with the accurate-before-a-change qualifier and every acknowledgment failure code; A's preview classes; retries, model calls, tokens and latency
statistics: PROTOCOL.md §6: per point; Wilson 95% per arm; Newcombe 95% for B − A; no hypothesis test, no composite score, no ranking
replay: PROTOCOL.md §7 and DRIVER.md §4: every recorded draw replayed without a model, with the same session pattern; everything but send times and latencies identical
seeds: development recordings only (41901, 41902, 42001, 42002); no reference, holdout, reserved or clinical seed

driver.method: each draw calls the arm's agent's own ask() on a pooled engine session of its point and arm; nothing of either workflow is reimplemented

shared: every arm: the recorded state (the point's digests, checked at every draw's start); the recorded request (system prompt and prompt), which the agent's own first request must equal byte for byte, its prompt rebuilt from the engine and the recording's memory text; the recorded initial proposal as the reply to it; the model's frozen settings file, loaded by the agent's own loader (maxRetries 1, allowDetails, timeout 300 s, decision budget 900 s); the same final-response schema; only a fully validated proposal submitted
differences: at a valid qualifying proposal, A shows the selective preview when eligible and B the acknowledgment request; at a valid non-qualifying proposal, A shows the preview when eligible and B calls no model; at a refused proposal both answer with the same validation feedback, and then differ at the corrected proposal as above. Model calls are counted and reported per draw, not equalized; at most 2 per draw in either arm (maxRetries 1)
authorization: run requires --authorization, the owner's authorization of this run quoted verbatim, recorded in run.json; the lock is not an authorization
